name: ToolbarStats
intent: A compact full-width metric strip that groups labeled values into equal-width cells for dashboards, tables, and operational workspaces.
when: Several related headline metrics need to share one compact horizontal region
Metric groups need clear dividers without building a dashboard grid
A toolbar or table header needs persistent summary statistics
whenNot: Only one headline metric is needed -> use MetricCard
Metrics need charts or trends -> use TrendChart
The values are row-level records -> use DataTable

chooseOver.because: ToolbarStats owns equal-width metric layout, grouped dividers, compact density, and negative-value treatment.

groups.note: Ordered groups of pre-formatted label/value metrics.

dataContract.note: Presentational and stateless; callers compute and format values.

variant.note: Cards renders separate stat cards; table renders one compact divided row.

className.note: Merged onto the root metric strip.

states.cards: Separate stat cards with group dividers and horizontal overflow when needed.
states.table: A bare row of full-height cells separated by borders.
states.negative: Metrics flagged negative use the destructive semantic text color.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using ToolbarStats as a generic layout component
commonMistakes.symptom: Non-metric content is squeezed into stat cells
commonMistakes.fix: Use a toolbar or grid component for actions and arbitrary content.

evaluationCriteria.check: ToolbarStats is selected as a widget for a composed metric strip, not as a primitive component.
Every metric renders a label and value; group boundaries and negative semantics remain visible.
